emergence.summary: Severe early-onset inherited retinal dystrophy. Loss-of-function of RPE65 -- the retinal-pigment-epithelium isomerohydrolase (retinoid isomerase) that converts all-trans-retinyl ester to 11-cis-retinol in the visual (retinoid) cycle -- lowers regeneration of the 11-cis-retinal chromophore, so rod and (progressively) cone photoreceptors cannot reconstitute light-sensitive visual pigment -> profound congenital/early-childhood vision loss with a characteristically severe ERG deficit out of proportion to early retinal structure. The disease is read as the retinoid-cycle / 11-cis-retinal-regeneration throughput axis driven DOWN (a deficient catabolic-cycle enzyme whose product fails -- the same enzyme-deficiency shape as the lysosomal storage and HPP reads, here on the RPE retinoid-cycle enzyme; the consequence is chromophore STARVATION rather than substrate storage). Correction is to restore the cycle: replace RPE65 at the locus, or supply the missing cis-retinoid chromophore downstream to bypass the block. The kit re-derives the approved replace arm -- voretigene neparvovec, an AAV2-hRPE65v2 subretinal gene-replacement therapy (the first in-vivo gene therapy approved in the US, 2017). This is the clean case where restoring the deficient gene IS the lead corrective lever -- in contrast to the upstream-restraint diseases (OTC, AIP, PH1) where the lead lever is NOT restoring the deficient gene but diverting an upstream over-accumulating flux; here the deficiency directly starves a needed product, so gene restoration is corrective. A first OCULAR / retinal read for the kit. The gamma read is of the RPE65 locus switch STRUCTURE (an AT-rich promoter, one of the lowest gamma in the kit); the disease lesion is coding (e.g. p.Pro25Leu, p.Tyr368His, founder splice alleles), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].

per_gene.note: RPE65 is the retinal-pigment-epithelium-specific 65 kDa isomerohydrolase that hydrolyses/isomerises all-trans-retinyl ester to 11-cis-retinol -- the rate-limiting regeneration step of the retinoid (visual) cycle that resupplies the 11-cis-retinal chromophore to opsins. LOF lowers 11-cis-retinal regeneration -> photoreceptors cannot reconstitute light-sensitive pigment -> severe early-onset retinal dystrophy (LCA2 / early-onset severe retinal dystrophy / retinitis pigmentosa 20). Located 1p31.3. NCBI official symbol RPE65. Autosomal recessive (biallelic). Coding/splice lesions (e.g. p.Pro25Leu, p.Tyr368His); promoter firewall respected.

falsifiers.claim: RPE65 LOF lowers 11-cis-retinal regeneration (chromophore supply fails)
falsifiers.falsifier: an RPE65 LOF allele that INCREASED 11-cis-retinal regeneration, or RPE/retina in which RPE65 loss RAISED chromophore supply or improved photoreceptor light response, refutes the throughput-down direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: retinal 11-cis-retinal content and rod/cone light response (ERG / single-cell) in RPE65-deficient retina (Rpe65 -/- mouse or dog, patient)

falsifiers.claim: restoring RPE65 (replace) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if restoring RPE65 expression REDUCED retinoid-cycle flux or WORSENED photoreceptor response, the 'replace gene' lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: 11-cis-retinal regeneration, ERG b-wave and full-field light sensitivity threshold response to RPE65 gene transfer in RPE65-deficient retina (the Briard-dog and Rpe65 -/- mouse models, patient)
